mapper.select: SELECT formula_id AS formulaId, formula_type AS formulaType, formula_kind AS formulaKind, params::text AS paramsJson, description FROM public.formula_profiles WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY formula_id

SELECT formula_id AS formulaId, formula_type AS formulaType, formula_kind AS formulaKind, params::text AS paramsJson, description FROM public.formula_profiles WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND formula_id = #{formulaId}

SELECT formula_id AS formulaId, formula_type AS formulaType, formula_kind AS formulaKind, params::text AS paramsJson, description FROM public.formula_profiles WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY formula_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.formula_profiles (game_id, formula_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, formula_type, formula_kind, params, description, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{formulaId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{formulaType}, #{formulaKind}, CAST(#{paramsJson} AS jsonb), #{description}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, formula_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, formula_type = EXCLUDED.formula_type, formula_kind = EXCLUDED.formula_kind, params = EXCLUDED.params, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.formula_profiles_log (game_id, formula_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, formula_type, formula_kind, params, description) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{formulaId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{formulaType}, #{formulaKind}, CAST(#{paramsJson} AS jsonb), #{description}) ON CONFLICT (game_id, formula_id, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, formula_type = EXCLUDED.formula_type, formula_kind = EXCLUDED.formula_kind, params = EXCLUDED.params, description = EXCLUDED.description
